# Tink

> European open banking platform owned by Visa, connecting 6000+ banks across Europe to enable financial data sharing, payment initiation, and data enrichment services.

Tink provides open banking infrastructure and APIs for transactions, payments, account verification, and risk assessment. Based in Stockholm, Sweden, Tink serves financial institutions, fintechs, and enterprises across the UK, Germany, Netherlands, and broader European markets with products like Money Manager, Account Check, and Pay by Bank.

## Key Topics

- Open banking
- Financial data enrichment
- PSD2 and API connectivity
- Account Check and Risk Signals
- Pay by Bank solutions
- Affordability assessment
- Responsible lending and credit risk
- Data-driven lending
- Consumer financial management
- Visa partnership
- European banking infrastructure
- Transaction data APIs
- Money Manager
- Cost-of-living analysis
- Customer case studies (Bank Norwegian, Kivra, An Post, Rocker)
